phase: 12 - representative ground-PV data acquisition + provenance audit (DISCOVERY ONLY, no training)

target_domain_profile.primary_objective: PANEL DETECTION (bounding boxes) on ground-level / rooftop RGB imagery
target_domain_profile.reference_set: six owner photos at D:/solar_ai_training_scratch/Solar Real Images (NOT training data; qualitative reference only)

reference_characteristics.content: close-up + oblique rooftop PV; large frame-filling panels; one wide multi-panel array; bird droppings / soiling; black roofing membrane in frame; varied daylight

priority_LOW: datasets with no panel localisation annotation

existing_datasets_for_overlap.datasets/ground_pv_research/yolo/: Susan-derived leakage-clean 3-class (panel/cracked/dusty), 6,492 images, ALL 640x640 (Roboflow stretch-resized). Source susan-ifblr/panel-solar-bw945; 'CC BY 4.0' displayed, image-level provenance unverified.
existing_datasets_for_overlap.datasets/ground_pv_research/condition/: S1 + S3 unified 5-class condition set, 2,509 images, ALL 640x640. Traces to Kaggle pythonafroz/solar-panel-images (licence Unknown), provenance grade C.
existing_datasets_for_overlap.datasets/ground_pv_research/candidate_de: S1, S3, C1, C3, S4, S6 - all Roboflow defect datasets, all ~640x640, all trace to the pythonafroz family (Phase 7 audit).

candidates.research_suitability: LOW - right viewpoint but near-zero physical-scene diversity (video frames of one site); ground-mounted not rooftop; provenance unresolved

scoring_rubric.note: Provenance and licence problems are reported as explicit PROVENANCE STATUS + RESEARCH SUITABILITY fields, NOT buried in the numeric score.

acquisition_recommendation: C - No suitable public dataset found. Pursue direct / permissioned data collection: capture a small owner/partner set of ground-level rooftop PV photos (portrait + landscape phone, oblique, close-up + array), with explicit permission, and hand-annotate panel bounding boxes. Optionally augment with the frame-diverse subset of P12-01 (bwpkx) as a RESEARCH-ONLY supplement once its provenance is resolved, treating its ~1-scene redundancy honestly.
